newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Queensland Sugar Corp executive wins treasury award.
newsitem.headline: Queensland Sugar Corp executive wins treasury award.

text.p: Queensland Sugar Corp's senior manager for risk management, John Bird, has won the inaugural Excellence in Treasury Award, presented by the Australian Society of Corporate Treasurers, Queensland Chapter.
The award, which is sponsored by Reuters, was presented to Bird at a corporate treasurers' luncheon meeting on Thursday.

Presenting the award's perpetual trophy to Bird, Corporate Treasurers' Queensland Chapter chairman John Letch said the quality of the nomination received on behalf of Bird demonstrated that the quality of treasury managers in Queensland matched that of peers in other states.
"John's contribution to the QSC was significant in enabling the corporation to meet its business goals," Letch said.

Handing Bird a winner's cheque for A$2,000, Reuters Queensland account executive Hector Ortiz said Reuters was proud to be involved with an award which recognised the significant contribution treasury personnel in Queensland made to the profession.
Bird won recognition for establishing a successful medium-term hedging programme and associated funding facility.
